message.reasoning: We need to answer. The question: "We want the annual discount now, not in eight months when our monthly term happens to end — can you make that switch effective immediately?" They want to switch from monthly to annual immediately. According to policy: Switching to annual takes effect immediately. So answer: Yes, you can switch to annual at any time from Settings → Billing → Plan, and it will take effect immediately, prorated, renewal date resets. So we can respond. No escalation needed.
